impact_scope.description: S1 introduces a new ETC1/ETC2 PKM image decoder implementing base.image_decoder; no matching decoder exists in S0.
S1 newly accepts PKM-framed ETC1 texture input, including a 16-byte header and 8-byte compressed 4x4 blocks.
Exercising the new decoder requires ETC2 module enablement and decoder construction, while H0 enables only BASE and JPEG and constructs a JPEG decoder.

evidence: In S0, std/etc2/decode_etc2.wuffs does not exist and the selected S0 context has no matching decoder declaration.
Therefore S0 has no ETC2/PKM decoder entry point, input format, or call protocol for H0 to expose.

gap_after.type: new decoder and input-format exposure gap
evidence: S1 adds the public decoder type implementing base.image_decoder and its decode_image_config, decode_frame_config, and decode_frame entry points for PKM/ETC input.
H0 compiles WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JPEG only, constructs wuffs_jpeg__decoder, and passes only that decoder to fuzz_image_decoder; it neither enables nor instantiates the new ETC2 decoder.
Consequently, fuzz-supplied PKM headers and ETC compressed blocks cannot reach the new S1 decoder through H0.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 must enable the ETC2 module, initialize and upcast an ETC2 decoder, and route fuzz-controlled PKM/ETC bytes through the image-decoder call sequence. None of these actions was needed in S0 because the decoder did not exist.
evidence: The production diff adds a new public decoder implementing base.image_decoder.
The decoder newly consumes a PKM header followed by ETC blocks through decode_image_config, decode_frame_config, and decode_frame.
H0's compile-time module selection and decoder construction are fixed to JPEG.

reason: Within the stable scope of the newly added ETC2/PKM decoder, S0 had no exposable functionality and thus no harness gap, whereas S1 introduces a public decoder and input format that unchanged H0 cannot compile, instantiate, or feed. This creates a concrete new harness obligation, so the delta is NEW and maintenance is needed.
